claim: n=3 confirmation of X215 routing on leaf-classification with the composite router. Results: above_median 2-of-3 (E-PN15 score 0.084 $16.95; E-PN16 score 0.046 $22.23) vs none 1-of-3 (E022 score 0.169 $12.03). The above-median rate is now 67% with score TRENDING TOWARD BRONZE (0.015) across runs: 0.169 → 0.084 → 0.046. Mean cost $17.07 vs X216 (opus-all + bigger search) $26.52 — X215 routing remains 36% cheaper at the same medal tier majority outcome. The original E022 medal=none result is increasingly LOOKING LIKE the outlier rather than the norm. Variance still real (std on cost ~$5), but the production X215 routing is now confidently characterized as 'cheaper than X216 with same-tier majority outcome.'
